name: StegBrowser Runtime Consumption
purpose: Execute the existing StegBrowser Canonical Work runtime-consumption chain on an admitted ephemeral StegOS node without creating a duplicate runtime, scheduler, WorkerCoordinator, credential path, or device dependency.
trigger: STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-CONSUMPTION-001 is PROPOSED/CHECKED_OUT and selected_execution_substrate is ADMITTED-EPHEMERAL-STEGOS-NODE
scope: one manifest-bound invocation for STEG-BROWSER-RUNTIME-CONSUMPTION-001 / COSV 40000100100000
reuse_instructions: Trigger once through scripts/trigger_reusable_task.py. The runner must reuse SovereignLocalEventRuntimeAdapter, the existing Canonical Work resident consumer, WorkerCoordinator, Interlock/InTr, exact stegbrowser_tvc_source_promotion consumer, TVC runtime/observer path, and Master Records lifecycle. It may stop only at a real authority/evidence/external-resource boundary and may not infer completion from source or CI. Canonical Work machine ingress requires the task coordination state to remain PROPOSED until authentic InTr admission projects INGRESS_ADMITTED.
